 Summary
 Alysson and Jackson make it 2-0 after four minutes 
 Fernandes pulls one back from the spot ; Tielemans levels against old club
 McGinn puts Villa back in front with penalty moments after half time & Goretzka makes it four 
 United currently in bottom three
 Hosts' only Premier League win this season came in August
 Villa looking to climb into top half
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Jess Anderson
 Most recent Most popular HITS THE WOODWORK published at 89 mins 89 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Mason Mount is unlucky not to claw one back here as he latches onto a good ball then clatters off the woodwork.
 376 301 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The players need to take responsibility' published at 18:19 GMT 18:19 GMT 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 The players have to take some responsibility. 
 Some of the individual mistakes from players today, the defending, has been really poor. 
 797 78 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 88 mins 88 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 It's looking like third time not so lucky for Manchester United.
 They came back from two goals down against Roma, then did it in the first half here but to overturn a two-goal deficit for a third time is seeming like a tall order.
 393 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 86 mins 86 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Another game, another goal for Nicolas Jackson.
 He makes way for 17-year-old Brian Madjo.
 985 117 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 83 mins 83 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 All the changes and stoppages mean we will probably get a decent chunk of added time.
 Enough for United to get something out of the game?
 333 2837 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:13 GMT 18:13 GMT 
 Click 'get involved' to send us your views 
 Credit to Emery, VIlla were on the backfoot by the end of the first half, but they came out guns blazing in the second. One of the world's best managers.
 Joshua 
 2923 389 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 83 mins 83 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 A first-half comeback was one thing, but a second-half one is looking less and less likely.
 Bryan Mbeumo makes way for Joshua Zirkzee.
 481 207 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 81 mins 81 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Bruno Fernandes concedes a free-kick for a foul on Ibrahim Mbaye.
 The urgency has gone from this game now and many Manchester United fans have seen enough and opt to head for the exits.
 1036 164 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 78 mins 78 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 More Villa changes.
 Johan Manzambi seemed fine but he makes way for Joao Gomes.
 Leon Goretzka is replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye.
 534 101 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:08 GMT 18:08 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Not sure how that challenge from Yoro hasn't been looked at more... It's clearly studs up and over the ball.
 Rory, Warwick 
 1479 504 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 77 mins 77 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 One thing about VAR is that they check fouls for red cards but then if it is decided it is not a red card then no card is shown at all because they can not intervene for a yellow.
 So therefore Yoro escapes without a booking in that instance. 
 250 750 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:04 GMT 18:04 GMT 
 Click 'get involved' to send us your views 
 Even if they sack the manager nothing will change as long as United are run like a business rather than a football club. As long as the money keeps coming in the owners simply do not care. The cycle will continue until the Glazers and Ineos are gone!
 Tim, London 
 4485 407 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'That's a sore one' published at 18:04 GMT 18:04 GMT 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 That does look sore, I think Leny Yoro got the ball but afterwards he did catch Johan Manzambi's ankle. It's one of those unfortunate ones where the impact takes you through. 
 182 455 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 72 mins 72 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Manchester United have just under 20 minutes to turn this around.
 As things stand, they will enter the international break inside the relegation zone.
 1270 201 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 72 mins 72 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Johan Manzambi goes down after Leny Yoro catches his studs on the outside of the Villa man's ankle.
 VAR check and clear it but Manzambi requires a bit of treatment.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 155 593 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 71 mins 71 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Unai Emery's turn to make some changes.
 Off: John McGinn and Alysson.
 On: Ross Barkley and George Hemmings.
 552 94 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'You just want to see Lacey on the ball' published at 18:01 GMT 18:01 GMT 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It's incredible when you see a young player like Shea Lacey come on, who's been through the club's academy, and they get such a big response from the fans. 
 We just want to see him get on the ball as much as possible in these last 20 minutes or so. 
 595 416 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 70 mins 70 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Oops. Leon Goretzka gives the ball away cheaply and it comes to Matheus Cunha but Zion Suzuki gets Goretzka out of trouble as he makes the simple save.
 296 85 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 67 mins 67 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 There was also a big cheer from the Old Trafford crowd as Diogo Dalot's number went up to say he was coming off.
 Ouch. Message = loud and clear.
 1672 189 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 67 mins 67 mins 
 Man Utd 2-4 Aston Villa 
 Manchester United make some changes.
 Youri Tielemans is replaced by Mason Mount and Diogo Dalot is replaced by Patrick Dorgu.
 Amad also makes way for Shea Lacey. A big cheer for the arrival of the 19-year-old.
